from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """Financial metrics extracted from a single company's quarterly report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock exchange code of the company")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period (e.g., '2025 Q1')")
    
    net_profit_attributable_to_shareholders: str | None = Field(description="Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders")
    operating_cash_flow_net: str | None = Field(description="Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities")
    operating_revenue: str | None = Field(description="Operating Revenue")
    accounts_receivable: str | None = Field(description="Accounts Receivable at period end")
    inventory: str | None = Field(description="Inventory at period end")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_reports: list[CompanyFinancialReport]
